name: Question 18
problem:
$$
B=[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 5 & -6 \\ 0 & 2 & 8 & -10 \\ 0 & 0 & 8 & -11\end{aligned}]
$$

 

If $B=LU$ is the LU decomposition of the matrix $B$ given above, what is the value of ${l}_{43}\cdot {u}_{24}?$
worked_solution:
Let's apply our standard LU factorization algorithm.

We reduce the matrix $B$ to row echelon form to obtain the matrix $U,$ as usual. However, instead of writing zeros below the main diagonal, we will instead write down the entries of the matrix $L.$

$$
\begin{aligned}B & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 5 & -6 \\ 0 & 2 & 8 & -10 \\ 0 & 0 & 8 & -11\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-2){R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 5 & -6 \\ 0 & \,2\, & -2 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 8 & -11\end{aligned}] & {R}_{4} & :={R}_{4}+4{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 5 & -6 \\ 0 & \,2\, & -2 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & -4 & -3\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain 

$$
L=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -4 & 1\end{aligned}],\,U=[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 5 & -6 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -3\end{aligned}].
$$

Finally, since ${l}_{43}=-4$ and ${u}_{24}=-6,$ we get

$$
{l}_{43}\cdot {u}_{24}=(-4)\cdot (-6)=24.
$$

B=[1−231015−6028−10008−11]R3:=R3+(−2)R2∼[1−231015−602−22008−11]R4:=R4+4R3∼[1−231015−602−2200−4−3]

Therefore, we obtain L=[10000100021000−41],U=[1−231015−600−22000−3].
